items.problem: The base position of a 2D camera is "the position of the attached camera", and `get_view_center` (camera-core.md:44) is "the world position at the screen center", but neither camera-core.md nor the `CameraCore` rows of skills/client-core/engines/godot.md:332-337 set how the engine camera properties that move the screen center away from the camera position are handled (for Godot `Camera2D`: `anchor_mode` `ANCHOR_MODE_FIXED_TOP_LEFT`, `offset`, `limit_*`, `position_smoothing_enabled`, `drag_*_enabled`). Run path: attach a `Camera2D` with `anchor_mode` = `ANCHOR_MODE_FIXED_TOP_LEFT` or `offset` ≠ 0, then call `get_view_center` and `screen_to_world`(center of the visible game area). One implementation takes `global_position` as the base position and leaves those properties as they are, so `get_view_center` differs from the drawn screen center and the bounds fitting (camera-core.md:109) and test camera-core.md:208 (position of c equals `get_view_center`) give different results from an implementation that resets those properties at attach or converts between camera position and screen center
